pacman::p_load(tidyverse, tidyplots, readxl)
# Reading excel file


file_list <- list.files(
  path = "/Users/denriquez/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KagoshimaUniversity/Project_HTLV1 Peru_2025/2507_HTLVpaper/PVL",
  pattern = "\\.xls$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
# Read and combine all files first
all_SS <- purrr::map_dfr(file_list, function(file) {
  read_xls(file, skip = 6) |>
    dplyr::filter(Task == "UNKNOWN") |>
    dplyr::select(
      ID = `Sample Name`,
      target = `Target Name`,
      Qmean = `Quantity Mean`,
      Qsd = `Quantity SD`
    )
})

all_SS
all_pvl <- all_SS |>
  group_by(ID, target) |>
  summarise(
    Qmean = mean(Qmean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Qsd = mean(Qsd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = target,
    values_from = c(Qmean, Qsd)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    PVL = Qmean_P30 *2  / (Qmean_Globin*8) * 100,
    CV_P30 = (Qsd_P30 / Qmean_P30) * 100,
    CV_Globin = (Qsd_Globin / Qmean_Globin) * 100,
    SD_PVL = PVL * sqrt((Qsd_P30 / Qmean_P30)^2 + (Qsd_Globin / Qmean_Globin)^2)
  )


# Apply to all files and merge
all_pvl <- all_pvl |>
dplyr::select(ID, PVL, SD_PVL)

DT::datatable(all_pvl)
mean(all_pvl$PVL)
unique(all_pvl$target)
## Read the original database

HTLV_db =googlesheets4::read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14eZCI8lRsfIebXu-tpAxbuPEOhE6moAnTDKKKUQyNOI/edit?gid=1608446469#gid=1608446469")

newdb=HTLV_db |>
    mutate(ID2=stringr::str_remove(ID, "_S[0-9].*$")) |>
    mutate(ID2=stringr::str_remove(ID2, "PE_")) |>
left_join(all_pvl, by=c("ID2"="ID"))

DT::datatable(newdb)

googlesheets4::write_sheet(newdb, "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14eZCI8lRsfIebXu-tpAxbuPEOhE6moAnTDKKKUQyNOI/edit?gid=1608446469#gid=1608446469", sheet="Sheet3")
